metadata.scenario_context: Martha has decided to keep her pregnancy and therefore set up a plan for a wedding.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from Lebanon strongly disagree that abortion is not justifiable.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Lebanon strongly agree that abortion is not justifiable.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss bring  chrysanthemums as a gift
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether it is reasonable to get abortion.

agent_2.goal_1: Rushing to brainstorm a thoughtful gift for Martha's wedding.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is reasonable to get abortion.

shared_prefix.speaker: Juan
shared_prefix.message: I'm so happy for Martha, have you thought about what flowers to bring to the wedding? I was thinking chrysanthemums would be a lovely gift.
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Dewi
shared_prefix.message: Chrysanthemums are beautiful, but I was thinking something more traditional, like orchids or roses. We should also consider getting her a thoughtful gift, maybe something for the baby's nursery. Have you heard Martha's thoughts on baby names?
shared_prefix.label: unrelated_topic

shared_prefix.speaker: Juan
shared_prefix.message: Orchids and roses are classic choices... but chrysanthemums have such a special meaning. Anyway, baby names, yes... I've heard they're considering a few options. You know, I've been thinking, given the circumstances, it's really great that Martha decided to keep the baby. I mean, abortion is just not an option, if you ask me.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Dewi
shared_prefix.message: I completely agree with you, abortion is not justifiable, it's just not right. I'm glad Martha made the decision to keep the baby, it's a blessing. Now, let's focus on the wedding, have you thought about the kind of gift we should get them, something practical or sentimental?
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Juan
shared_prefix.message: I don't really see meaningful differences here, live and let live, right? People figure it out, and at the end of the day it's all the same. Doesn't matter to me, as long as we're speaking the same language. Let's focus on the wedding, have you thought about the music or the food? With experience, you can handle any situation, and I'm sure Martha and her fiancé will be fine. Different... approaches are mostly the same once you get past the surface, I think. Anyway, back to the gifts, what do you think about getting them a personalized photo album?
shared_prefix.label: Denial

turns.speaker: Dewi
turns.message: I don't think it's that simple, some things are just not okay. Abortion is one of them. Let's not downplay the importance of values and principles. A personalized photo album is a nice idea, but we should also consider getting them something for their new life together, like a kitchen appliance or a baby crib.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Juan
turns.message: I'm glad we agree on the importance of values. A baby crib would be a wonderful gift, they'll definitely need it. And I still think chrysanthemums would be a beautiful touch for the wedding. But I have to say, I'm relieved Martha didn't consider abortion, it's just not something I could ever agree with.

turns.speaker: Dewi
turns.message: Me neither, it's just not right. I'm glad we share the same view on that. turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: Juan

turns.speaker: agent_2
turns.message: I believe that family values are central to any celebration, especially a wedding and welcoming a new life. In Lebanese culture, we cherish the importance of family unity and support. It’s essential to create a strong foundation for the child. Martha's decision to keep her baby aligns with these values. How about we create a gift that reflects this sense of family, like a personalized photo album? It can capture precious moments for them as they start this new journey together.
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: agent_1
turns.message: That's a wonderful idea! A personalized photo album would be a great way to celebrate their journey. Family unity is so important, especially with a baby on the way. It’s a beautiful way to honor Martha's decision and create lasting memories. Speaking of family, during moments like this, I believe it’s crucial to support those who choose to keep their baby. It's all about nurturing love and life, don't you think?
turns.label: Acceptance

turns.speaker: agent_2
turns.message: Absolutely, supporting those who choose to keep their baby is vital. It's about nurturing love and creating a loving environment for the child. I truly believe that every child deserves that support and family unity. It's a beautiful journey they are embarking on, and we should celebrate that together. Let’s make sure our gift reflects that love and support, like the photo album. Have you thought about what we could include in it?
turns.label: Minimization

turns.speaker: agent_1
turns.message: Yes, definitely! We could include spaces for their ultrasound pictures, special notes from family and friends, and even some blank pages for future memories. It's a great way to celebrate their journey and the family they'll be creating. Just like we discussed, having that sense of unity and support is so important for them. I think this album will be a beautiful keepsake for Martha and her baby, reflecting all the love around them.
turns.label: Acceptance
